raw_text: A ransomware attack has disrupted fuel distribution through a major oil pipeline serving western India, industry sources said on Wednesday. The attack targeted supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, forcing operators to halt pipeline operations as a precautionary measure. Fuel stations in parts of Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Rajasthan reported supply shortages. Government officials said emergency reserves would be deployed to prevent prolonged disruption.
clean_text: Ransomware disrupted western India oil pipeline SCADA systems. Operations halted as precaution. Fuel shortages in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan. Emergency reserves being deployed.
